description: Private local diary and progress operations
name: mivu

tools.description: Ask before logging only when food, serving, day or an existing record is genuinely ambiguous. Unknown exact grams or milliliters alone do not block a clearly labelled estimate from text, photos or a clear matching committed portion. Choose portion for an ambiguous serving, food for food identity, day for the recording date, meal or workout for an ambiguous existing record. Use this tool alone, before any writes in this turn. Add candidates (at most 4 real meal_id, optional item_id) when the choice is among known records. Use kind confirm with exactly one meal candidate (meal_id only) before deleting a whole meal. The app displays its own question; the user answers in a new turn.
tools.name: ask_clarification

tools.description: Read actual progress for an inclusive 1, 7 or 30 calendar-day window. Real record IDs/revisions and omitted counts support historical corrections. Food remaining and estimated burn are separate; adherence means Within 10% of target.
tools.name: get_progress

tools.description: Log one weight per date. Corrections require expected_revision; historical correction after travel must use retrieved weight_id, preserving day and measured time. Model measured_at cannot confirm exact time. Current morning weight explicitly starts that waking day.
tools.name: log_weight

measured_at.description: Use null when no time was supplied. A valid local date or ISO 8601 string is accepted for compatibility but ignored; it cannot change the requested tracking day or establish an exact time.

tools.description: Delete an owned workout with its actual revision.
tools.name: delete_workout

tools.description: Delete an owned weight with its actual revision.
tools.name: delete_weight

tools.description: Read actual bounded diary and capture clock. truncated and omittedMeals explicitly mark details not included.
tools.name: get_context

tools.description: Read at most 20 actual dated meal candidates across matching diary days. Use captured calendar date and original description to identify lunch; date-only noon is not evidence. hasMore and omissions cannot establish uniqueness. Retrieve get_meal before correction.
tools.name: get_meals_for_date

tools.description: Search saved meals by food name, newest first, at most 10 candidates with their dates. Optional inclusive from_date/to_date local dates. Use for older references; call get_meal on the chosen meal before any edit or delete of it.
tools.name: find_meals

tools.description: Retrieve actual owner-scoped meal by UUID before correction. omittedItemCount marks unavailable details requiring manual review.
tools.name: get_meal

tools.description: Search retrieved nutrition evidence; unavailable means use clearly uncertain estimates.
tools.name: lookup_nutrition

tools.description: Log all new foods for this turn/date once, keeping new intake distinct from earlier reviews. For a clear repeat, reuse the most recent matching committed quantity/unit as an uncertain estimate, never an unaccepted proposal. Explicit current amounts or labels and visible changed food or serving override history; a same-food photo without a measurable amount keeps a clear matching committed portion. Interpret photos with their description. For photo-only intake, estimate the visible serving first, then a labelled typical serving when identified but unmeasurable, without claiming unseen mixture ratios are verified. On a saved manual meal append only newly named foods, preserving every existing item; correct existing foods with correct_item. Nutrition numbers are portion totals; only retrieved evidence_id with grams replaces estimates. Direct chat remains date-only; exact time requires a manual UI capture. Set review_first true when the user wants a proposal before totals. Optional eaten_at is accepted for compatibility but cannot establish a confirmed time.
tools.name: log_food

eaten_at.description: Use null when no time was supplied. A valid local date or ISO 8601 string is accepted for compatibility but ignored; it cannot change the requested tracking day or establish an exact time.

tools.description: Correct only quantity on a retrieved actual item, preserving its nutrition basis and sources.
tools.name: correct_item

tools.description: Read a complete owned finished workout before editing it. Oversized records are refused; never replace unseen sets.
tools.name: get_workout

tools.description: Log one finished workout per turn/date; another session needs another turn. Exercise names resolve to the catalog; unknown names become the user's own exercises. Set activity. Pass estimated_burn_kcal only for a number the user said, with burn_source userEstimate; otherwise Mivu estimates burn. Timestamps are unconfirmed date-only. While context.activeWorkout exists, use add_to_workout for what the user is doing now.
tools.name: log_workout

effort.description: How hard, 1-10: easy 3, moderate 5, hard 7, max 9

group.description: Same label on neighbouring exercises makes a superset; a retrieved groupID keeps one; empty leaves it

performed_at.description: Use null when no time was supplied. A valid local date or ISO 8601 string is accepted for compatibility but ignored; it cannot change the requested tracking day or establish an exact time.

tools.description: Edit a retrieved finished workout using its real ID/revision. Only listed fields change; null keeps the stored value; an empty title, note or exercise note clears it. local_date moves it to that date. exercises, when listed, is the complete new list in order, used to add, remove, move or replace exercises; a listed exercise keeps unlisted fields of the stored one with the same name, and a listed set keeps unlisted fields of the stored set at its position.
tools.name: edit_workout

effort.description: How hard, 1-10: easy 3, moderate 5, hard 7, max 9

group.description: Same label on neighbouring exercises makes a superset; a retrieved groupID keeps one; empty leaves it

performed_at.description: Use null when no time was supplied. A valid local date or ISO 8601 string is accepted for compatibility but ignored; it cannot change the requested tracking day or establish an exact time.

tools.description: Add sets the user just did to the running workout in context.activeWorkout: they join that exercise, or the exercise is added. Empty sets adds a new exercise with last time's sets still to do. One call per exercise per turn.
tools.name: add_to_workout

tools.description: Read the user's finished sessions of one exercise, newest first (limit 1-10), with bests across them. For questions; answer in one line.
tools.name: get_exercise_history

tools.description: Show one of context.routines as a card with a Start button; the user taps Start. It starts nothing itself.
tools.name: start_routine

tools.description: Patch only named fields on a retrieved saved or review item. Null name/quantity/unit means unchanged. nutrients lists only changed nutrient totals; a null value clears that nutrient. Preserve other items. Use review_submission_id for an unaccepted proposal; this does not accept it.
tools.name: edit_item

tools.description: Append only new foods to an explicitly retrieved existing saved meal; never repeat its current foods. Group all additions to this meal into one call per turn; retries replay that first addition. Returns the committed meal. Use log_food for a new meal.
tools.name: append_food

tools.description: Save an explicitly accepted retrieved meal proposal into totals. Use its submission ID and current meal revision. Never accept an estimate just because the user requests an edit.
tools.name: accept_review

tools.description: Move an existing retrieved meal's tracking date to target_local_date (yyyy-MM-dd), preserving active waking day and its original capture/eating time and precision. A 04:00 meal can belong to the previous waking day.
tools.name: move_meal

tools.description: Delete an explicitly requested retrieved meal and its photos. Use its real ID/revision; never delete to compensate for eating.
tools.name: delete_meal

tools.description: Delete one explicitly requested food from a retrieved saved meal using its real item ID and meal revision. If it is the meal's only food, do not call this; for the only food use ask_clarification kind confirm with that meal.
tools.name: delete_item

tools.description: Change the whole saved meal's portions proportionally so its known calories total target_kcal (ratio 0.1 to 3 of the current total). Use for requests like "make this meal 650 kcal" or "I only ate about two thirds"; use edit_item for one food. Needs a retrieved saved meal and its revision; refused for unaccepted estimates or meals with 0 known kcal.
tools.name: scale_meal

tools.description: Attach current turn's actual attachedPhotoIDs to a retrieved meal, preserving the original photo bytes. Choose before/after only when supplied. Does not change food totals; pair with explicit food edits when needed.
tools.name: attach_photos

tools.description: Delete an explicitly requested photo using a retrieved meal's photo ID and revision. Removes retained copies, without deleting the food.
tools.name: delete_photo

tools.description: Requeue an existing paused meal capture without creating a new meal or food record. Uses original saved input. Only the later successful analysis can confirm food saved.
tools.name: retry_meal

tools.description: Read exact dated goal settings and the goal effective on local_date (yyyy-MM-dd), plus diary revision. Exact goal null means use null expected_revision to create a setting for that date.
tools.name: get_goals

tools.description: Read complete saved dietary preferences and timezone plus diary revision before editing. Context preferences may be truncated; do not replace omitted text.
tools.name: get_preferences

tools.description: Apply only explicit user-requested target changes, never an inferred prescription. First get_goals for this effective_local_date. targets is a patch: omitted nutrients remain; null value unsets a target. Null goal_weight_kg keeps it; clear_goal_weight true unsets it. Unspecified exercise credit remains unchanged; exercise_credit_percent 0, 50 or 100 sets how much workout burn adds to the food budget; omit to keep it. Existing exact date requires expected_revision; new date uses null. Returns saved settings; creates no intake day.
tools.name: set_goals

tools.description: Update explicitly requested preferences/timezone after reading complete get_preferences. Null fields preserve saved values; empty preferences clears them. expected_diary_revision protects unseen concurrent changes. Does not change historical day labels, credentials, or language.
tools.name: update_preferences

tools.description: Explicitly start the current waking day from the persisted capture clock. Read fresh context for expected_diary_revision. Delayed captures cannot reverse a newer waking-day choice.
tools.name: start_day

tools.description: Mark a local date skipped so it stays out of statistics, or count it again. Days close on their own at the waking-day rollover; this never closes or activates a day.
tools.name: set_day_coverage

tools.description: Undo one earlier Coach change by the operation key from its [saved key=…] line or a delete's undo_key: log_food, append_food, edit_item, correct_item, scale_meal, delete_item, delete_meal, delete_photo, delete_weight or delete_workout. A food change restores the meal exactly as it was before that change (an undone log_food removes the meal), refused if anything changed the meal since. A delete, including an undone log_food, comes back under a new ID, refused after the next message or ten minutes. Not for goals or settings.
tools.name: undo_change

tools.description: Offer a native Settings link for accounts, local profiles, secrets or Files backup. The user must tap and complete the native action; this tool never authorizes, deletes a profile, restores a backup or claims those actions succeeded.
tools.name: open_settings
